old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a glass filled with a dark red beverage, likely cola, with ice cubes floating on top. The glass is positioned against a dark background, which enhances the vibrant color of the drink. Condensation is visible on the surface of the glass, indicating the cold temperature of the beverage. The ice cubes are static. The lighting highlights the surface of the liquid and the ice, adding texture and depth to the scene. The overall atmosphere is cool and refreshing, emphasizing the appeal of the drink. There are no other objects or characters present in the video, focusing solely on the glass and its contents. The camera remains stationary throughout, maintaining a consistent perspective that allows viewers to appreciate the details of the drink and its surroundings.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a glass filled with a dark red beverage, likely cola, with ice cubes floating on top. The glass is positioned against a dark background, which enhances the vibrant color of the drink. As the video progresses, small droplets of condensation form on the surface of the glass, indicating the cold temperature of the beverage. The ice cubes shift slightly due to the movement of the liquid, creating a dynamic visual effect. The lighting highlights the bubbles rising to the surface, adding texture and depth to the scene. The overall atmosphere is cool and refreshing, emphasizing the appeal of the drink. There are no other objects or characters present in the video, focusing solely on the glass and its contents. The camera remains stationary throughout, maintaining a consistent perspective that allows viewers to appreciate the details of the drink and its surroundings.
caption: The video captures a close-up of a clear glass tumbler filled with a dark amber-red carbonated drink, with ice cubes protruding above the rim against a near-black, backlit background. The glass and ice remain fixed in place, while the liquid surface height and cube arrangement stay essentially unchanged. Carbonation bubbles keep forming, cling to the ice faces and inner glass wall, and rise through the glowing liquid. Their distribution shifts from moment to moment, creating moving sparkles and subtle changes in the thin water films on the cubes. Specular highlights on the ice move slightly as the bubbles and films change, not as the cubes themselves translate. Thin vertical bright streaks appear intermittently near the top edge of the frame, but no splash, entry point, or impact is visible. The camera viewpoint is stationary, so the rim, background, and overall composition remain constant in the frame. The visible process is ongoing fizzing and bubble motion within a full glass, with the drink still in progress.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
